title: itembank quality finding
description: One machine-readable record from the second quality gate (Phase 11, AUDIT-07/D-09/D-10). Exactly four independently named deterministic detectors run after lint; each emits its own record with versioned measured evidence and a concise remediation -- never an aggregate score. A profile may change severity but can never erase evidence (11-04 assumption probe).

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

detector.description: The named detector that produced this record (AUDIT-07).

detector_version.description: The version of the detector rule that produced this record (D-09).

severity.description: The disposition of the finding; machine-authored items must pass every block finding before a write (D-11).

code.description: The stable dotted code an authoring agent branches on.

item.description: The item reference this finding is about (for example Q3, or the literal BANK for a bank-wide finding).

evidence.description: The measured values behind the finding -- explainable, versioned, and detector-specific (D-10).

threshold.description: Optional human-readable threshold summary; the numeric bounds always live inside evidence.

remediation.description: The concise actionable remediation an authoring agent can act on.

per_letter_counts.description: Letter -> count for keyed MC positions.

max_share.description: The top position's share; blocks only above block_above.

score.description: Jaccard of the normalized non-stopword token sets.

run.description: The contiguous normalized content-token run leaked into the stem.

competing_options_with_run.description: Incorrect options sharing the run; when empty the run is a unique leak.

would_be_condition.description: Whether the rationale states the condition under which the option would be correct.
